intent: Explain why nothing is shown and what the user can do about it, in a sentence or two under the title.
typical_uses: The muted sentence beneath EmptyTitle giving the reason for the empty state or the next step

dont_use_when.situation: The description of a card that holds real content

invariants.text: Any descendant a inherits the description's muted color, is underlined with a 4px offset, and turns var(--link-foreground) on hover.

anti_patterns.dont: Put a short count or hint in EmptyDescription as a second line
anti_patterns.do_instead: Give the secondary line its own EmptyDetail after the description, which sets it on the smaller meta type

good.title: A description with an inline link
good.code: No projects yet. Read how projects work.

bad.title: A count crammed into the description
bad.code:
<EmptyHeader>
  <EmptyTitle>No results</EmptyTitle>
  <EmptyDescription>Try a different search term. 3 filters applied.</EmptyDescription>
</EmptyHeader>
bad.why: The count is a secondary line; EmptyDetail sets it on the meta type with its own spacing under the description.
